description:
Find Your Calm | Sarangi Instrumental | 1.5 Hours to Quiet a Racing Mind

The day is over but your mind has not been told. If your thoughts keep circling - replaying, planning, worrying about tomorrow - let this play and give them somewhere softer to land.

This gentle Indian sarangi music is designed to quiet an overactive mind in the evening: long singing phrases that slow your breathing and take the edge off, so calm has room to come back.

Enjoy 1.5 hours of warm bowed sarangi, tender and voice-like, over a steady tanpura drone, with no drums and no vocals.

▶ Stay in the calm — the full Healing & Anxiety Relief playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VIDEO_ID&list=PLeZN0byo199k-_9PNqaU2-Z_KhRN_X1hF
(paste this video's own id in place of VIDEO_ID before publishing — it opens the playlist at this video so the next one plays automatically)

Perfect for calming anxiety in the evening, overthinking at night, winding down after work, meditation, breathwork, journaling, a warm bath, reading, or the hour before sleep.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Sarangi (Indian bowed string instrument) with tanpura
Raga: Yaman (an expansive, open evening raga)
Style: Indian classical instrumental, meditative
Mood: Tender, steady, reassuring
Atmosphere: Lamplight, the day behind you, breathing slowing down
Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

🎧 HOW TO USE
Play it when the thoughts start to spin. Sit or lie down, let the long bowed notes stretch your exhale, and stop trying to solve anything for a while. Headphones bring out the voice-like warmth of the sarangi; soft speakers work well in a bedroom.
